finalists.label: Compartment Syndrome
finalists.why: This candidate has strong evidence for compartment syndrome, including bilateral foot drop, elevated CPK, and indirect signs of myositis and panniculitis.

finalists.label: Neuropathy
finalists.why: This candidate has strong evidence for neuropathy, including bilateral peroneal nerve paralysis and bilateral motor nerve block below the fibular head.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it accounts for the most decisive findings in the vignette, including bilateral foot drop and elevated CPK, which are more specific to compartment syndrome than to neuropathy.
